items.text: AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO ENVIRONMENTAL CONSERVATION

items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to excluding
deer management professionals retained by the incorporated village of Lloyd
Harbor
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S1093

SPONSOR: GAUGHRAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to
excluding deer management professionals retained by the incorporated
village of Lloyd Harbor

 
PURPOSE:

The legislation would exclude deer management professionals from the
rifle-hunting ban in Lloyd Harbor.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 amends paragraph a of subdivision 5 of section 11-0931 of the
environmental conservation law to exclude deer management professionals
from the rifle-hunting ban in the Village of Lloyd Harbor.

Section 2 is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

For several years the Village of Lloyd Harbor successfully mitigated
issues of deer overpopulation through the engagement of Professional
Wildlife Managers. However, due to state law prohibiting the use of
rifles on Long Island, these much needed services are no longer avail-
able to the Village. The Village notes that the ever-increasing deer
population is a matter of public health, safety and environmental degra-
dation. The Village reports that while this program operated in the
Village, they were able to enact a comprehensive and extremely efficient
deer management program.

The deer population needs to be regulated, as it is a matter of public
health and safety. Overpopulation causes residents on Long Island to
experience increased deer-related auto accidents, environmental and
residential damage, and tick-related illnesses. rose dramatically all in
relation to the rising deer population. This limited exception would
allow the Village to continue to address the myriad of issues that over-
population of deer presents in the community.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2020: 58065

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.
